summary: Full backend + frontend regression for Stock Intel Bot. 12/12 pytest cases pass. All data-testid elements present in React dashboard; scan trigger + watchlist + alerts CRUD all functioning end-to-end. Claude cache verified (claude_calls_made=0 on second scan; cache_hits == pre_filter_passed). MongoDB _id is stripped in every endpoint response inspected. Scheduler starts on boot (log: 'Scheduler started: daily 8AM ET scan + 5min alert check'). Telegram gracefully reports configured:false with empty placeholder token.

minor.issue: On invalid JSON body, endpoint returns 200 with {ok:false} — acceptable per design but could be 400 for strictness

critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 161: alerts_add uses `dict(doc)` before insert (good, avoids _id mutation) and response spreads `doc` — safe.

claude_service.analyze_batch: if EMERGENT_LLM_KEY missing, function silently returns cached-only results with no error surfaced to caller. Consider raising/logging when to_analyze is non-empty but no key is configured.

scrapers.fetch_quote: yfinance calls are synchronous and wrapped via run_in_executor — fine, but no caching; repeated /api/watchlist calls will refetch every ticker quote each request (performance concern with large watchlists).
server.py /api/watchlist GET: sequentially awaits fetch_quote per ticker — O(n) latency. Consider asyncio.gather for parallel quote fetch.
server.py /api/alerts POST: uses dict(doc) to strip Mongo _id mutation; clean. Good.
No rate-limit or auth on /api/scan/run — publicly triggerable. Acceptable for MVP admin dashboard but worth noting.
test_credentials: N/A — no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST watchlist entry AAPL and alert AAPL@150 which are then deleted. UI test left TSLA in watchlist and NVDA@100 alert — harmless residue.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend Claude cache is populated from prior runs (date_key=today). Second /api/scan/run should always return claude_calls_made=0 if identical candidates. If scrapers hit rate limits, pre_filter_passed may drop to 0 — test is structured to accept that. External URL: https://stock-scout-bot.preview.emergentagent.com.
